E-source-1.title: Implementing security and responsible AI - AWS Prescriptive Guidance
E-source-1.applicability: Covers model assessment for bias/fairness, documentation preparation (model cards), technical safeguards for privacy/PII, deployment approval workflows, and governance setup addressing training data provenance and ethical deployment approval as specified in area boundaries

passages.text: During the model assessment phase, the evaluation report helps the organization understand the model's robustness and explainability through quantitative and qualitative analyses. This analysis includes evaluating accuracy metrics, fairness scores, and error distributions, complemented by human-in-the-loop reviews and A/B testing to validate real-world performance.

A model card should include detailed specifications of the model architecture, training methodology, and hyperparameter configurations, along with performance metrics across diverse datasets and demographic groups. It must also explicitly outline both intended use cases and scenarios where the model should not be applied, establishing clear boundaries for appropriate deployment.

E-source-2.title: Ethics for AI System Design Training
E-source-2.applicability: Provides frameworks for implementing ethical principles in AI development cycles, including documented model choices, bias evaluation methodologies, training data provenance considerations, and deployment approval processes aligned with technical implementation boundaries

passages.text: This training helps bridge the gap between principles and practice, enabling real-world implementation of ethically aligned systems design strategy from the planning phase.

concerns.description: Evaluation of model fairness using quantitative metrics across demographic groups with human-in-the-loop validation
Documentation of model performance across diverse datasets including intended and prohibited use cases
Implementation of technical safeguards including PII sanitization to prevent privacy violations
Training for implementing ethically aligned design strategies from the planning phase
